headline: North Star must grow 4.5x, clients only 2.1x
subline: Every metric in the brief · today vs 30 June 2027
annotation: Growth must come from existing clients climbing faster and dropping less.
source: Source: case study brief; North Star counted since the silent launch; share = North Star / clients.
notes: All the numbers from the brief on one page. Top row is the target: the North Star must grow 4.5 times, from 28 thousand to 125 thousand net level-ups, while the client base only doubles. So the share of clients who level up must more than double, from 4.7 to 10 percent.

Middle row is behaviour. 22.6 thousand clients dropped a level since October, largely because points follow account balances. The targeted pilot enrolled 24.6 percent against 13 percent at the silent start, and reward choice fell from 63 percent in the pilot to 34 in the rollout.

Bottom row is value. Finance says the programme is not yet profitable, and for share of wallet and value-for-money NPS the brief gives no baseline. That is exactly why one source of truth is my first priority.
